title: a death the owner rejected is no death evidence
line: a person whose only death evidence is a claim the owner rejected is no longer deceased on it: at tier 2 unknown and assisted, as with no death held; the file's claim set back to undecided is held again and makes them deceased

steps.say: a grandparent whose death the file claims: deceased on the evidence

expect.why: the file's undecided claim of a death is held by the tree: death evidence

steps.say: the rest of her baseline reviewed on the file's claims

expect.why: a rejected claim is no evidence: the tier rule reads her as it reads a grandparent with no death held
unknown at tier 2: a search on her is assisted, never automatic

steps.say: the owner takes the rejection back: the claim is undecided and the tree holds it again

expect.why: an undecided claim counts: the tree holds it
